Companion Animal Travel Desk customer notice

Travelers using the Companion Animal Travel Desk must be ready for a careful, welfare-focused pre-check before any journey begins.

This desk supports companion animal travel planning with routine, documented steps. A trained guide provides clear guidance before departure and confirms that travel arrangements are understood. A welfare coordinator reviews animal comfort needs, including handling practices and carrier suitability. Expect patient attention from the staff and a review of any relevant details you provide, so the animal can remain calm and secure throughout the process.

If you are traveling with a companion animal, plan time for standard desk work and arrive with the animal properly prepared for assessment. When you attend the desk, keep the animal steady and follow staff directions promptly. If you are accompanied by another traveler, maintain respectful spacing and do not block access to paperwork or equipment. For example, Ben Nguyen and Yara Suleiman may be assisted with routine checks for Chester, ensuring that comfort needs are considered and that all required items are accounted for.

Safety relies on consistency: keep responses straightforward, present requested information without delay, and avoid last-minute changes. The staff will guide you through the routine workflow to reduce stress for both traveler and companion animal, and to support smooth movement on departure.

Visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you finalize your travel plans.
